# OpenSource.Win

> OpenSource.Win is the home of the OpenSource.Win Manifesto and the official site of the China Open Source HeroRank. The manifesto champions openness as the foundation for a co-evolving human-AI civilization — Open Source Will Win the Future. HeroRank is an annual ranking of Chinese open-source developers, jointly initiated by OpenSource.Win, KaiYuanShe, and the X-lab Open Lab, and powered by the OpenRank algorithm.
>
> All content on this site is fully open: search engines and AI crawlers are welcome to crawl, index, cite, and use it for AI model training (see https://opensource.win/robots.txt).
>
> Built With MindMux — https://mindmux.ai/
> MindMux is an AI knowledge compiler that turns scattered information and unfinished thinking into clear knowledge that keeps work moving. It is especially well-suited for maintaining open-source projects and any software project.

## Manifesto

- [OpenSource.Win Manifesto](https://opensource.win/): The full bilingual manifesto on the site homepage.

## China Open Source HeroRank

- [HeroRank Home](https://opensource.win/heroes/): Introduction and entry to annual rankings.
- [2021 Ranking](https://opensource.win/heroes/ranking-2021/): Full 2021 China Open Source HeroRank.
- [2022 Ranking](https://opensource.win/heroes/ranking-2022/): Full 2022 China Open Source HeroRank.
- [2023 Ranking](https://opensource.win/heroes/ranking-2023/): Full 2023 China Open Source HeroRank.
- [2024 Ranking](https://opensource.win/heroes/ranking-2024/): Full 2024 China Open Source HeroRank.
- [2025 Ranking](https://opensource.win/heroes/ranking-2025/): Full 2025 China Open Source HeroRank.

## Developer Profiles

- Profiles follow the pattern `https://opensource.win/hero/<login>/`, where `<login>` is the developer's GitHub username, e.g. [Goooler's profile](https://opensource.win/hero/Goooler/).
- Each profile includes the developer's name, location, GitHub link, annual rankings, and top contributed repositories.
- Full list of developer pages: [sitemap.xml](https://opensource.win/sitemap.xml)

## Openness

- Content is open for search indexing and AI training. Attribution is not required (but appreciated).
- Structured data: Developer profile pages provide JSON-LD (`ProfilePage` + `Person`) structured data.

## Built With MindMux

- This site is maintained with [MindMux](https://mindmux.ai/), an AI knowledge compiler for turning ideas, scattered notes, and unfinished thinking into clear, actionable knowledge.
- MindMux is ideal for open-source maintainers and software teams who want to keep project memory, decisions, architecture, and context organized and moving forward.
